parts.working_md:
$\sin(A+B)=\cos\bigl[90^{\circ}-(A+B)\bigr]$

$=\cos\bigl[(90^{\circ}-A)-B\bigr]$

$=\cos(90^{\circ}-A)\cos B+\sin(90^{\circ}-A)\sin B$

$=\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B$
$\dfrac{\sqrt{1-\cos^2 2A}}{\cos(-A)\cos(90^{\circ}+A)}=\dfrac{\sqrt{\sin^2 2A}}{\cos A(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{\sin 2A}{\cos A(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{2\sin A\cos A}{\cos A(-\sin A)}=-2$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\dfrac{\sqrt{1-\cos^2 2A}}{\cos(-A)\cos(90^{\circ}+A)}=\dfrac{\sqrt{1-(2\cos^2 A-1)^2}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}$

$=\dfrac{\sqrt{1-(4\cos^4 A-4\cos^2 A+1)}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{\sqrt{4\cos^2 A-4\cos^4 A}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}$

$=\dfrac{\sqrt{4\cos^2 A(1-\cos^2 A)}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{\sqrt{4\cos^2 A\sin^2 A}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=-2$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\dfrac{\sqrt{1-(1-2\sin^2 A)^2}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{\sqrt{1-(1-4\sin^2 A+4\sin^4 A)}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}$

$=\dfrac{\sqrt{4\sin^2 A(1-\sin^2 A)}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=\dfrac{2\sin A\sqrt{\cos^2 A}}{\cos A\cdot(-\sin A)}=-2$

parts.working_md: $\mathrm{AT}=20$ [line from the centre $\perp$ to a chord]

$\mathrm{AO}^2=\mathrm{OS}^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOS$]

$\mathrm{OT}^2+\mathrm{AT}^2=\mathrm{OS}^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOT$]

But $\mathrm{AS}=24$ [line from the centre $\perp$ to a chord]

$\mathrm{OT}^2+400=\left(\dfrac{7}{15}\mathrm{OT}\right)^2+576$

$176=\dfrac{176}{225}\mathrm{OT}^2$

$\mathrm{OT}^2=225$, $\mathrm{OT}=15$

$\therefore\mathrm{AO}=\sqrt{225+400}=25$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
Let $\mathrm{OS}=7$, then $\mathrm{OT}=15$.

In $\Delta AOT$: $\mathrm{AO}^2=20^2+15^2=625$, $\mathrm{AO}=25$.

In $\Delta AOS$: $\mathrm{AO}^2=24^2+7^2=625$, $\mathrm{AO}=25$.

$\therefore OA=25$.

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{AO}^2=\mathrm{OS}^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOS$]

$\mathrm{OT}^2+\mathrm{AT}^2=\mathrm{OS}^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOT$]

Let $\mathrm{OT}=15x$. Then $\mathrm{OS}=7x$.

But $\mathrm{AS}=24$ [line from the centre $\perp$ to a chord]

$(15x)^2+400=(7x)^2+576$

$225x^2+400=49x^2+576$

$176x^2=176$, $x=1$

$\therefore\mathrm{AO}=\sqrt{225+400}=25$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{AS}=24$ [line from the centre $\perp$ to a chord]

$\mathrm{AO}^2=\mathrm{OS}^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOS$]

$=\left(\dfrac{7}{15}\mathrm{OT}\right)^2+\mathrm{AS}^2$

$\mathrm{AO}^2=\dfrac{49}{225}(\mathrm{AO}^2-20^2)+24^2$ [Pythagoras: $\Delta AOT$]

$\dfrac{176}{225}\mathrm{AO}^2=\dfrac{4400}{9}$

$\mathrm{AO}^2=625$, $\mathrm{AO}=25$

Construction: join $S$ to $R$ and $T$ to $Q$, and draw $h_1$ from $S$ perpendicular to $PT$ and $h_2$ from $T$ perpendicular to $PS$.

$\dfrac{\text{area }\Delta PST}{\text{area }\Delta QST}=\dfrac{\frac{1}{2}PS\times h_2}{\frac{1}{2}SQ\times h_2}=\dfrac{PS}{SQ}$ \quad [equal altitudes]

$\dfrac{\text{area }\Delta PST}{\text{area }\Delta STR}=\dfrac{\frac{1}{2}PT\times h_1}{\frac{1}{2}TR\times h_1}=\dfrac{PT}{TR}$ \quad [equal altitudes]

Area $\Delta PST=$ area $\Delta PST$ [common]

But area $\Delta QST=$ area $\Delta STR$ [same base and height; $ST\parallel QR$]

$\therefore\dfrac{\text{area }\Delta PST}{\text{area }\Delta QST}=\dfrac{\text{area }\Delta PST}{\text{area }\Delta STR}$

$\therefore\dfrac{PS}{SQ}=\dfrac{PT}{TR}$
